metadata.title: Stars in the Local Galactic Thick Disk and Halo in Gaia EDR3: A catalogue of Half a Million Local Main-sequence Stars with Photometric Metallicities

notes: No eligible stars. The paper presents a catalogue of local thick-disk/halo main-sequence candidates and describes them as halo stars (T:p5-b5; T:p18-b8), but it does not state that any star is unbound from the Milky Way or report an unbound/escape-velocity criterion. High tangential velocity and reduced proper motion are used for halo selection, not Galactic-unbound candidacy.
